signatureEngine.name: 硫磺石
signatureEngine.requirement: 装备者的特性与音擎适配特性一致时，音擎效果生效。

refinements.name: 炽烈吐息
refinements.description: [普通攻击]、[冲刺攻击]或[闪避反击]命中敌人时，装备者的攻击力提升3.5%，最多叠加8层，持续8秒，0.5秒内最多触发一次，每层效果单独结算持续时间。
refinements.descriptionEn: Upon hitting an enemy with a Basic Attack, Dash Attack, or Dodge Counter, the equipper's ATK increases by 3.5% for 8s, stacking up to 8 times. This effect can trigger once every 0.5s. The duration of each stack is calculated separately.

refinements.name: 炽烈吐息

refinements.descriptionEn: Upon hitting an enemy with a Basic Attack, Dash Attack, or Dodge Counter, the equipper's ATK increases by 4.4% for 8s, stacking up to 8 times. This effect can trigger once every 0.5s. The duration of each stack is calculated separately.

basic.name: 普通攻击：热身火花
basic.trigger: 点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
basic.description:
点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
向前方进行至多四段的斩击，造成物理伤害。
basic.descriptionEn:
Press [Basic Attack] to activate:
Unleashes up to 4 slashes, dealing Physical DMG.

special.name: 特殊技：烈火
special.trigger: 点按 【特殊技键】 发动：
special.description:
点按 【特殊技键】 发动：
向身周进行斩击，造成火属性伤害；
招式发动期间抗打断等级提升。
special.descriptionEn:
Press [Special Attack] to activate:
Slashes enemies nearby, dealing Fire DMG.
Anti-Interrupt level is increased while using this skill.

ex.name: 强化特殊技：盛燃烈火
ex.trigger: 能量足够时，点按 【强化特殊技键】 发动：
ex.triggerEn: With enough Energy, press [EX Special Attack] to activate:
ex.description:
能量足够时，点按 【强化特殊技键】 发动：
向身周进行强力斩击，造成大量火属性伤害；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果；
招式发动后，[普通攻击]和[冲刺攻击]必定触发[火力镇压]，最多持续30秒或触发8次。
ex.descriptionEn:
With enough Energy, press [EX Special Attack] to activate:
Slashes enemies nearby, dealing massive Fire DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
After using this skill, Soldier 11's Basic Attacks and Dash Attacks will trigger Fire Suppression for up to 30s or 8 times.

dodgeCounter.name: 闪避反击：逆火
dodgeCounter.trigger: 触发[极限闪避]后，点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
dodgeCounter.triggerEn: Press [Basic Attack] during a Perfect Dodge to activate:
dodgeCounter.description:
触发[极限闪避]后，点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
对前方敌人发动强力斩击，造成大量火属性伤害；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
dodgeCounter.descriptionEn:
Press [Basic Attack] during a Perfect Dodge to activate:
Executes a powerful slash against enemies in front, dealing massive Fire DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

chain.name: 连携技：昂扬烈焰
chain.trigger: 触发[连携技]时，选择对应角色发动：
chain.triggerEn: When a Chain Attack is triggered, select the character to activate:
chain.description:
触发[连携技]时，选择对应角色发动：
对前方小范围敌人进行强力上挑斩击，造成大量火属性伤害；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果；
招式发动后，[普通攻击]和[冲刺攻击]必定触发[火力镇压]，最多持续30秒或触发8次。
chain.descriptionEn:
When a Chain Attack is triggered, select the character to activate:
Unleashes a powerful upward slash at enemies in a small area, dealing massive Fire DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
After using this skill, Soldier 11's Basic Attacks and Dash Attacks trigger Fire Suppression for the next 30s, up to 8 times.

ultimate.name: 终结技：轰鸣烈焰
ultimate.trigger: 喧响等级达到[极]时，点按 【终结技键】 发动：
ultimate.triggerEn: When Decibel Rating is at Maximum, press [Ultimate] to activate:
ultimate.description:

When Decibel Rating is at Maximum, press [Ultimate] to activate:

quickAssist.name: 快速支援：火力掩护
quickAssist.trigger: 当前操作中的角色被击飞时，点按 【切换键】 发动：
quickAssist.triggerEn: When the active character is launched, press [Switch] to activate:
quickAssist.description:
当前操作中的角色被击飞时，点按 【切换键】 发动：

quickAssist.descriptionEn:
When the active character is launched, press [Switch] to activate:

Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

defensiveAssist.name: 招架支援：巩固防线
defensiveAssist.trigger: 前场角色即将被攻击时，点按 【切换键】 发动：
defensiveAssist.triggerEn: When the character on field is about to be attacked, press [Switch] to activate:
defensiveAssist.description:
前场角色即将被攻击时，点按 【切换键】 发动：
招架敌人的攻击，累积大量失衡值；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
defensiveAssist.descriptionEn:
When the character on field is about to be attacked, press [Switch] to activate:
Parries the enemy's attack, dealing massive Daze.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

assistFollowup.name: 支援突击：重燃
assistFollowup.trigger: 发动[招架支援]后，点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
assistFollowup.triggerEn: Press [Basic Attack] after a Defensive Assist to activate:
assistFollowup.description:
发动[招架支援]后，点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
对前方敌人发动交叉斩击，造成火属性伤害；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
assistFollowup.descriptionEn:
Press [Basic Attack] after a Defensive Assist to activate:
Charge and cross slash enemies in front, dealing Fire DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

facts.text: 「11号」在[普通攻击]或[冲刺攻击]中触发[火力镇压]时，招式造成的伤害提升70%。
facts.textEn: When triggering Fire Suppression during a Basic Attack or Dash Attack, increase that attack's DMG by 70%.

cinema.name: 快速升温
cinema.description: 成为接战状态下的当前操作角色时，若「11号」的能量不足40点，则立即回复至80点，50秒内最多触发一次。
cinema.descriptionEn: When Soldier 11 becomes the active character in combat, if her Energy is less than 40, her Energy is recovered to 80. This effect can trigger once every 50s.

cinema.name: 高温汇聚
cinema.description: 触发[火力镇压]时，[普通攻击]、[冲刺攻击]、[闪避反击]造成的伤害提升3%，最多叠加12层，持续15秒，每层效果单独结算持续时间。
cinema.descriptionEn: When triggering Fire Suppression, Basic Attack, Dash Attack, and Dodge Counter DMG increases by 3%, up to 12 stacks, lasting 15s, with the duration of each stack calculated separately.

cinema.name: 精锐士兵
cinema.description: [普通攻击]、[闪避]、[支援技]、[特殊技]、[连携技] 技能等级+2
cinema.descriptionEn: Basic Attack, Dodge, Assist, Special Attack, and Chain Attack Lv. +2

cinema.name: 纵情燃烧
cinema.description: [普通攻击]第一、二、三段或[冲刺攻击]发动时，若触发[火力镇压]，则在招式发动期间抗打断等级提升，受到的伤害降低18%；[普通攻击]第四段发动时，若触发[火力镇压]，则在招式发动期间获得无敌效果。
cinema.descriptionEn:
If Fire Suppression is triggered during the 1st, 2nd, or 3rd hit of Soldier 11's Basic Attack or a Dash Attack, Anti-Interrupt Level increases and DMG received is reduced by 18% during skill activation.
If Fire Suppression is triggered during the 4th hit of her Basic Attack, she becomes invulnerable during skill activation.

cinema.name: 完美士兵
cinema.description: [普通攻击]、[闪避]、[支援技]、[特殊技]、[连携技] 技能等级+2
cinema.descriptionEn: Basic Attack, Dodge, Assist, Special Attack, and Chain Attack Lv. +2

cinema.name: 炽热心流
cinema.description: 发动[强化特殊技]、[连携技]或[终结技]时，「11号」获得8层充能（上限8层）；触发[火力镇压]时，消耗1层充能，使当前招式无视目标25%火属性伤害抗性。
cinema.descriptionEn:
When Soldier 11 uses her EX Special Attack, Chain Attack, or Ultimate, she gains 8 stacks of Charge (max 8 stacks).
When Fire Suppression is triggered, 1 stack of Charge is consumed, causing the current move to ignore 25% of the target's Fire RES.
